UXG.source: the uxg line runs UniFiOS, whose shared capability-copy routine returns before storing anything when the device is on firmware >= 4.1.0 and reports an empty or absent udapi_version -- dropping if_table, uplink, port_table, the caps set and all of it silently. A non-empty udapi_version disarms that; caps stays empty so no capability (e.g. BGP) is falsely claimed. Only UXGENT additionally reports a routing capability. Legacy ugw (USG) is not on this path and sends no udapi_version.
